meta.name: adaptyv
meta.description: How to use the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK for protein experiment design, submission, and results retrieval. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Adaptyv, Foundry API, protein binding assays, protein screening experiments, BLI/SPR assays, thermostability assays, or wants to submit protein sequences for experimental characterization. Also trigger when code imports `adaptyv`, `adaptyv_sdk`, or `FoundryClient`, or references `foundry-api-public.adaptyvbio.com`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提交蛋白序列开展结合与稳定性实验,取回测定结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做蛋白工程实验,想要一套清晰的送检与结果获取指南。
copy.tagline_en: Submit protein sequences for binding and stability assays, then retrieve results.

howto.what: 会用云端实验室的 Foundry API 规范帮你写代码:查靶点、估算费用、提交蛋白序列做结合/筛选/热稳定性等实验,并跟踪状态、取回结果。
howto.when: 当用户提到 Adapyv、Foundry API,要求做结合/筛选等实验,或想提交蛋白序列做表征;检测到代码导入 adaptyv、adaptyv_sdk 或 FoundryClient 也会触发。

say.text: 帮我把这几条序列提交一个 BLI 结合筛选实验,靶点选 EGFR。
say.note: 会先查 EGFR 靶点、估算费用,再创建草稿实验。

say.text: 看看我刚提交的实验出结果了吗?
say.note: 会查询实验状态;状态为 Done 时能取回结果。

say.text: 帮我估算这三条序列做热稳定性实验的费用。
say.note: 会返回一份费用估算,不会自动提交。

howto.what_en: Writes code following the Foundry API specs: find targets, estimate costs, submit protein sequences for binding/screening/thermostability assays, track status, and fetch results.
howto.when_en: Triggered by mentions of Adapyv or Foundry API, binding/screening assay requests, or requests to submit protein sequences for characterization; also when code imports adaptyv, adaptyv_sdk, or FoundryClient.

say_en.text: Submit these sequences as a BLI binding screen against EGFR.
say_en.note: It looks up EGFR, estimates cost, then creates a draft.

say_en.text: Has my submitted experiment produced results yet?
say_en.note: It checks status and fetches results when done.

say_en.text: Estimate the cost of a thermostability assay for these three sequences.
say_en.note: Returns a cost estimate before anything is submitted.
